items.title: Extract lifecycle dispatch and runCli orchestration helpers
items.context: Move lifecycle-specific dispatch branches and runCli orchestration helpers into a dedicated module while preserving command execution, stdout/stderr, and error semantics.
items.userSees: Focused smoke output includes `lifecycle dispatch smoke passed`; INIT_CHECK dry-run output still includes `[DRY-RUN] INIT_CHECK bootstrap plan` and `no phase, branch, commit, or worktree changes were made`.
excludes: Do not move business handlers or storyMachine transition guards.
Do not rewrite generic parse/validate/run wrapper order beyond calling extracted lifecycle helper functions.
Do not change command names, aliases, help text, or JSON stdout contracts outside lifecycle special dispatch.

happy.desc: story_create and story_advance INIT_CHECK special dispatch move behind a lifecycle-dispatch helper while preserving the visible next-step text and handler invocation order.

edge.desc: Nested command aliases, command help, command ownership policy, and phase allowlist still flow through the existing shared run wrapper before lifecycle helper execution.

adversarial.desc: The extraction must not bypass reviewer-readonly gate, story owner lease gate, hook ordering, activity logging, or wantsMachineJson hint suppression.

verificationEvidence.note: Commit 2839def41 extracts story_create/story_advance INIT_CHECK dispatch from cli-engine.ts into cli/lifecycle-dispatch.ts while preserving the shared run wrapper call sites.
TypeScript build passed after extraction, proving cli-engine orchestration imports and helper dependency wiring compile.
Scope contract passed with lifecycle-dispatch.ts and recover/init-check helper creates classified as allowed.

items.title: Extract INIT_CHECK metadata sync and recover helpers
items.context: Move commitInitCheckMetadataAndMergeMain and related metadata sync/recover handling behind stable APIs without weakening worktree/main consistency gates.
items.userSees: INIT_CHECK reconcile smoke still observes `INIT_CHECK metadata committed` and `main merged into story/`; recover_evidence failure output still prints JSON with `status` before stderr `recover_evidence refused` or `recover_evidence: validate failed after refresh`.
excludes: Do not change StoryStore persistence semantics or storyMachine guard predicates.
Do not change Authority receipt classification or productionDone derivation.
Do not change main write lock implementation beyond preserving existing call sites through extracted sync helpers.

happy.desc: commitInitCheckMetadataAndMergeMain and related bounded metadata reconcile helpers move to init-check-metadata-sync while cli-engine.ts keeps a compatibility export.

edge.desc: INIT_CHECK metadata conflict resolution still resolves only machine-owned story metadata to the base branch version and aborts non-metadata conflicts without markers.

adversarial.desc: recover_evidence special dispatch still prints structured refused/fail JSON before returning non-zero and refuses unsupported dirty categories.

items.title: Verify lifecycle and merge-main safety after extraction
items.context: Run build, lifecycle smoke commands, process fact contract checks, and any focused tests covering INIT_CHECK metadata and DONE/merge-main preconditions.
items.userSees: Verification transcript should include `lifecycle dispatch smoke passed`, `lifecycle-registry consistency: PASS`, `command-ownership contract passed`, and `main-write-lock-coverage:` with no scope-contract violations.

Do not defer behavior verification to docs-only review; lifecycle smoke evidence is required.
Do not mark DONE if validation evidence goes stale after implementation changes.

happy.desc: TypeScript build and focused lifecycle-dispatch smoke pass after extraction.

edge.desc: INIT_CHECK metadata commit/merge, conflict reconciliation, command ownership, main-write-lock coverage, lifecycle registry, and process-fact contracts remain green.

adversarial.desc: No lifecycle, Authority, reviewer, owner-lease, process-fact, or JSON stdout semantic regression is introduced by the extraction.
